limits: Finite retained execution evidence is not a proof of compiler correctness, whole-language soundness, global optimality, or Rust performance superiority.
musl evidence covers the two complete generic memcmp/bcmp files on this Linux x86_64 host only, using the Rust reference backend. It is not a full libc migration or seven-platform musl qualification.

Seven native host receipts cover the existing finite scalar/ordinary-record/nested-array/pointer/register-spill ABI profile. Packed records, bitfields, varargs, general foreign lifetimes, physical boards, MMIO/DMA/IRQ and GPU execution remain outside scope.

Host ZIPs retain reports and raw setup/adapter-test logs, but not remote native objects or executables. Their ZIP/member bytes and report consistency can be checked here; remote binary hashes remain recorded execution evidence, not independently rehashed remote binaries.
Resource normal returns are checked for zero live owners/loans/chains/bytes. Trap and budget stops preserve their actual ledger and do not claim cleanup.

Source borrowed-return helpers use checked projection inlining; primitive cross-call Loan returns, arbitrary stored returned source borrows, asynchronous cancellation, native resource refinement and production Rust admission are not established.
Upstream source identity is checked against retained release metadata and the frozen repository fixture; this audit does not refetch or independently authenticate the upstream release archive.

limits: 219 tests are the selected 26-module verified-increment suite, not the full repository regression.
The CI receipt explicitly records untracked artifacts/verified-optimization/ and recursive-ndu-source/. Source inventory unchanged does not mean the whole CI worktree was clean.

C++ observations cover the scoped lexical ownership fixture using C++, source-to-C, source-to-Rust and the source owned-LLVM backend. They do not prove HIA-to-native refinement, general C++ RAII, source equivalence, or whole-language safety.
Adaptive evidence is empty-state pure-u64 native execution with explicit version selection. Automatic profitable selection, automatic benefit, and general live-state/owner migration remain false.
Native binaries present in this ZIP are rehashed without executing them; compiler tool binaries and separate NDU bridge binaries are not included and their hashes remain recorded evidence.

The 300-member ZIP is fully byte-audited. This small audit checks selected regression, scoped C++ and adaptive reports in depth; it does not independently reassess NDU performance claims or rerun SMT obligations.
